info.title: Space Hub API (target)
info.description:
Binding OpenAPI for Hub under `/api/v1`. Hand-written target contract. `scripts/export-openapi.ps1` does not generate or overwrite this file.

## Document role
This file is the **binding source of truth** for Hub `/api/v1` implementation (auth, JWKS, people, invites, project membership, admin).
It is **not** the PDF domain transcript and **not** the exported host reality (`hub.openapi.json`), which may lag the target.

Domain intent lives in `docs/Drive-API-contracts 2.pdf` and `docs/Drive-API-contracts.openapi.json`. Map PDF requirements into this file before implementing.

Drive storage/content/dispatches live in `docs/drive.openapi.json`. Hub is the sole JWT issuer; Drive verifies via JWKS.

## Base URL
All routes are under `/api/v1`.

## Resource URL rules
- Plural resource nouns; interactions are named after the thing created (`invite-resends`, `account-deletions`), not verbs.
- Related 1:1 media use pseudoresources (`user-avatars/{id}`, `invite-logos/{token}`).
- Filtered collections use query parameters (`project-members?projectId=`, `project-member-candidates?projectId=`), not nested parent paths.
- Workspace-scoped people/invite admin calls send `X-Workspace-Id`.
- Project references use `projectId` / `projectName` (not `groupId`) on Hub v1 invites and members.
- Canonical GET/PATCH/POST success bodies for the same resource use one representation.
- Related collections return ids; login/token responses may include workspace role fields needed to bootstrap the client.

## Authentication
- `POST /api/v1/sign-ins` and `POST /api/v1/two-factor-confirmations` are anonymous.
- Public invite preview and invite logo/inviter-avatar routes are anonymous.
- `POST /api/v1/invite-acceptances` is anonymous (token in body).
- Every other route requires `Authorization: Bearer` with a Hub-issued access JWT (or Hub-issued app token where noted).
- `loginChallenge` is a temporary backend session key for a login attempt, not a password.

## JWT claims (minimum)
`sub` (user id), plus workspace memberships with workspace role (`Owner|Manager|Creator|Viewer|Customer|Custom`). No project or file permissions in the token.

## Lists
Collection GETs use `page` (default 1), `pageSize` (default 20, maximum 100), and `sort`.
Values outside the allowed ranges return `400` with `error: invalid_pagination` or `invalid_sort` and are not clamped.
Response envelope: `{ page, pageSize, totalCount, items }`.

## Image negotiation
Avatar and invite image GETs: omitted `Accept`, `*/*`, or `image/*` returns image bytes. Other types return `406`.

## Errors
Every `4xx` and `5xx` is `application/problem+json` (`ProblemDetails`). Every response includes `X-Request-Id`.
Priority: `401` → `403` → `400` → `404` → `406` / `409` / `410` / `502` as documented per operation.
Invite accept account mismatch uses ProblemDetails with `error: account_mismatch` and `invitedEmail`.

## Legacy mapping
Reshaped operations also set `x-legacy-paths` and a `Replaces:` line in the operation description.

| New | Old (prior hub-target / PDF) |
|-----|------------------------------|
| `GET/PATCH /api/v1/users/current` | `GET/PATCH /api/v1/me` |
| `POST /api/v1/account-deletion-challenges` | `POST /api/v1/me/profile/delete-request`; PDF `/me/profile/delete-request` |
| `POST /api/v1/account-deletions` | `POST /api/v1/me/profile/delete-confirm`; PDF `/me/profile/delete-confirm` |
| `GET /api/v1/user-avatars/{id}` | `GET /api/v1/users/{id}/avatar`; PDF `/users/{id}/avatar` |
| `POST /api/v1/project-memberships` | `POST /api/v1/users/{id}/project-memberships`; PDF `/users/{id}/add-group` |
| `PUT /api/v1/user-project-accesses/{userId}` | `PUT /api/v1/users/{id}/project-memberships`; PDF `/users/{id}/group-access` |
| `POST /api/v1/project-membership-removals` | `POST /api/v1/users/{id}/project-membership-removals`; PDF `/users/{id}/remove-group` |
| `GET/POST /api/v1/invites` + `X-Workspace-Id` | `GET/POST /api/v1/workspaces/{workspaceId}/invites`; PDF `/workspaces/{workspaceId}/invites` |
| `GET /api/v1/invites?mine=true` | `GET /api/v1/me/invites`; PDF `/me/invites` |
| `DELETE /api/v1/invites/{inviteId}` | `DELETE /api/v1/workspaces/{workspaceId}/invites/{inviteId}` |
| `POST /api/v1/invite-resends` | `POST .../invites/{inviteId}/resend`; PDF `.../resend` |
| `POST /api/v1/invite-acceptances` | `POST /api/v1/invites/{token}/accept`; PDF `/invites/{token}/accept` |
| `GET /api/v1/invite-previews/{token}` | `GET /api/v1/invites/{token}`; PDF `/invites/{token}` |
| `GET /api/v1/invite-logos/{token}` | `GET /api/v1/invites/{token}/logo`; PDF `/invites/{token}/logo` |
| `GET /api/v1/invite-inviter-avatars/{token}` | `GET /api/v1/invites/{token}/inviter`; PDF `/invites/{token}/inviter` |
| `GET /api/v1/project-member-candidates` | `available[]` on prior `GET .../members` / `GET .../project-members` |
| `GET/POST /api/v1/project-members` | `GET/POST /api/v1/group-members` (prior target); `GET/POST /api/v1/groups/{id}/members`; PDF `/groups/{id}/members` |
| `POST /api/v1/project-member-removals` | `POST /api/v1/group-member-removals` (prior target); `DELETE /api/v1/groups/{id}/members/{userId}`; PDF same |

post.summary: Sign in with user name and password.
post.description: Unchanged from prior hub-target. Starts a login attempt. When two-factor is required, returns a loginChallenge. Tokens are issued only by two-factor-confirmations.

post.summary: Complete sign-in with a two-factor code.

201.description: Login succeeded. Access and refresh JWTs are in the body; no Location.

get.summary: Public JWKS for verifying Hub-issued JWTs.
get.description: Unchanged from prior hub-target. Consumed by Hub and Drive. Anonymous.

post.summary: Issue an app/session token for an editor or Drive client.
post.description: Unchanged from prior hub-target. Issued by Hub. Drive only consumes the token.

201.description: A new app token was issued.

get.description: Replaces: GET /api/v1/me. Signed-in account in context.

post.summary: Request an account deletion challenge code.

201.description: Challenge and masked email. No Location; challenge is not an addressable resource URL.

post.description: Replaces: POST /api/v1/me/profile/delete-confirm; POST /me/profile/delete-confirm (PDF). Tokens stop working.

get.summary: List members of the current workspace.
get.description: Unchanged path from prior hub-target; list now uses page/pageSize/sort and a paged envelope.

post.description: Unchanged from prior hub-target. Direct creation disabled; invite instead.

410.description: Direct creation disabled; invite instead. ProblemDetails error body.

patch.summary: Update a member's workspace role, permission code, or startup scene.

delete.summary: Remove a member from the workspace.
delete.description: Unchanged from prior hub-target. Triggers Drive membership sync for that workspace.

post.description: Replaces: POST /api/v1/users/{id}/project-memberships; POST /users/{id}/add-group (PDF). No role per project. Hub syncs membership into Drive DB.

201.description: Projects added. Body echoes projectIds. No Location for batch create.

put.summary: Replace a member's project access list.
put.description: Replaces: PUT /api/v1/users/{id}/project-memberships; PUT /users/{id}/group-access (PDF). Projects left off are removed. Hub syncs into Drive DB Pseudoresource: full replacement of that user's project access list.

post.description: Replaces: POST /api/v1/users/{id}/project-membership-removals; POST /users/{id}/remove-group (PDF). Hub syncs deletes into Drive DB.

get.description: Replaces: GET /api/v1/workspaces/{workspaceId}/invites; GET /api/v1/me/invites; GET /workspaces/{workspaceId}/invites (PDF); GET /me/invites (PDF). With X-Workspace-Id: pending workspace invites. With mine=true (no workspace header): invites for the signed-in person. Sending both mine=true and X-Workspace-Id returns 400 invalid combination.

parameters.name: X-Workspace-Id
parameters.description: Required when mine is false or omitted. Forbidden/ignored when mine=true.

post.description: Replaces: POST /api/v1/workspaces/{workspaceId}/invites; POST /workspaces/{workspaceId}/invites (PDF). Workspace from X-Workspace-Id.

201.description: Resend accepted; invite returned with emailSent.

502.description: Mail failed; invite link still returned as PendingInvite.

get.summary: Workspace logo for the invite page.
Inviter avatar for the invite page.

post.description: Replaces: POST /api/v1/invites/{token}/accept; POST /invites/{token}/accept (PDF). On success Hub syncs assigned project membership into Drive DB. Wrong signed-in user → 403 ProblemDetails error account_mismatch.

201.description: Joined workspace; returns Hub JWTs. No Location.

get.description: Replaces: GET /api/v1/group-members; GET /api/v1/groups/{id}/members; GET /groups/{id}/members (PDF). Filter: projectId (required). Does not include available people; use GET /api/v1/project-member-candidates.

post.description: Replaces: POST /api/v1/group-members; POST /api/v1/groups/{id}/members; POST /groups/{id}/members (PDF). Users must already belong to the workspace. Hub syncs membership into Drive DB.

201.description: Members added. Body lists created memberships (same ProjectMember shape as GET).

get.summary: List workspace people available to add to a project.
get.description: Replaces: available[] nested on GET /api/v1/groups/{id}/members and GET /api/v1/project-members. Filter: projectId (required).

200.description: Paged candidates not yet in the project.

post.summary: Remove one person from a project.
post.description: Replaces: POST /api/v1/group-member-removals; DELETE /api/v1/groups/{id}/members/{userId}; DELETE /groups/{id}/members/{userId} (PDF). Hub syncs membership delete into Drive DB.

get.description: Unchanged path from prior hub-target; list now uses page/pageSize/sort and a paged envelope.

delete.summary: Delete an account as platform administrator.
delete.description: Unchanged path from prior hub-target; success is 204 with empty body. 409 if the account still owns a workspace.

bearerAuth.description: Hub-issued access JWT or app token. Not used by anonymous sign-in or public invite routes.

RequestId.description: Server-generated request id. Matches requestId in ProblemDetails.

WorkspaceIdHeader.name: X-Workspace-Id
WorkspaceIdHeader.description: Current workspace id for website people/invite/group calls.

Page.name: page
Page.description: 1-based page index. Default 1. Values below 1 return 400 invalid_pagination.

PageSize.name: pageSize
PageSize.description: Page size. Default 20. Values outside 1–100 return 400 invalid_pagination and are not clamped.

SortUsers.name: sort
SortUsers.description: Allowed: email, fullName, role, id. Prefix - for descending. Default email. Unknown → 400 invalid_sort.

SortInvites.name: sort
SortInvites.description: Allowed: createdAt, email, expiresAt, id. Prefix - for descending. Default -createdAt.

SortProjectMembers.name: sort
SortProjectMembers.description: Allowed: email, fullName, id. Prefix - for descending. Default email.

SortAdminUsers.name: sort
SortAdminUsers.description: Allowed: email, fullName, createdAt, id. Prefix - for descending. Default email.

MineInvites.name: mine
MineInvites.description: When true, list invites for the signed-in person (matched by email). Do not send X-Workspace-Id. Equality match.

AcceptImage.name: Accept
AcceptImage.description: omitted, */*, or image/* returns image bytes. Any other value returns 406.

ProjectIdQuery.name: projectId
ProjectIdQuery.description: Project id. Equality match. (Legacy name: groupId.)

BadRequest.description: The query or body is invalid. error is validation_failed, invalid_pagination, or invalid_sort.

Unauthorized.description: Authentication failed. Wins over validation, missing resource, and unacceptable Accept.

Forbidden.description: Authenticated but not allowed. Invite accept account mismatch uses error account_mismatch and invitedEmail.

NotFound.description: The resource does not exist or is not visible to the caller.

NotAcceptable.description: The Accept value cannot be produced.

Conflict.description: Conflict with current state (for example admin delete while the account still owns a workspace).

Gone.description: No longer available (used, withdrawn, or expired invite; disabled create).

BadGateway.description: Upstream dependency failed (for example invite resend mail failure).

ProblemDetails.description: RFC 9457 problem body used for every 4xx and 5xx response. May include invitedEmail when error is account_mismatch.

error.description: Machine-readable code. validation_failed, invalid_pagination, invalid_sort, account_mismatch, …

requestId.description: Server-generated request id. Matches the X-Request-Id header.

errors.description: Present when error is validation_failed. Keys are camelCase field names.

loginChallenge.description: Challenge from TwoFactorChallenge. Temporary login-attempt key, not a password.

TokenPair.description: Hub-issued JWTs after successful two-factor confirmation or token refresh.

method.description: How the code was sent, such as email or totp.

JsonWebKeySet.description: JWKS document for verifying Hub-issued JWTs.

app.description: App identifier supplied by the editor/Drive client.

RefreshAppTokenRequest.description: Empty object. Authorized by the bearer app token being refreshed.

CurrentUser.description: Signed-in account. Same shape for GET and PATCH /users/current.

workspaceIds.description: Workspace membership ids. Details via workspace-scoped people routes.

WorkspaceMember.description: Workspace member. projectIds are project/group ids only; no roles per project.

projectIds.description: Project/group ids the member can access.

UpdateWorkspaceMemberRequest.description: Changes workspace role, permission code, or startup scene. No project roles.

ProjectIdList.description: Project/group ids only. No roles per project.

projectId.description: Required unless the invite is for an Owner. Legacy: groupId.

PagedInvites.description: Paged invites. Same InviteListItem shape for workspace lists and mine=true.

InvitePreview.description: Public invite preview. Flat fields; no nested workspace/inviter objects.

CreateInviteAcceptanceRequest.description: token is required. username/password/fullName required for a new account; may omit when already signed in as the invited email.

ProjectMembersPage.description: Paged members of a project. Available candidates: GET /api/v1/project-member-candidates.

InviteListItem.description: Invite row for paged lists. workspaceId/workspaceName set for mine=true; project fields set for workspace-scoped pending invites.
